risk_note: RV2 (db/migrations, data only). BR-FUND-13 / ledger-plan D6 A: users registered before B2-02g (#934) have no balance account. One new migration backfills them: INSERT ... SELECT a USER_BALANCE row in app.ledger_accounts per app.users row (app_id and owner_id from the user, id gen_random_uuid() like the ledger's randomUUID, created_at column default) ON CONFLICT (app_id, owner_type, owner_id, subject) DO NOTHING; then a zero row in app.account_balances (available 0, frozen 0, version 0, negative_since NULL) for every user USER_BALANCE account that lacks one, ON CONFLICT (account_id) DO NOTHING. Existing rows, amounts and versions untouched; rerunnable; platform accounts untouched; no UPDATE / DELETE / DDL / DO block / grant change; SET LOCAL lock_timeout 5s and statement_timeout 120s. No schema change (db:check clean). Rule tests run the migration SQL as couli_app (decision 35); production runs it as couli_migrator. The file takes the next free number at landing (decision 36).
